goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: T001 is consistent with the brief: the workspace is implementation-empty, while Phase 0 explicitly calls for local workspace/bootstrap tooling and a blank branded shell. This is the largest reversible vertical slice. Public repository creation, Tower/Coolify, DNS, credentials, provider activation, commits, pushes, and database/auth work remain external or prohibited.

worker_package.objective: Implement the local Phase 0 pnpm/Turborepo bootstrap and a working blank-but-branded Next.js App Router / shell, with strict TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, Vitest, environment schema, local CI configuration, truthful legal/governance placeholders, one ADR, and an implementation ledger. Pin exact dependency versions in manifests and lockfile and record them in the ADR. Do not commit, push, create repositories or pull requests, activate Tower/DNS/providers, or invent institutional claims.
verify: $hits = rg -n -i 'next-auth|prisma|drizzle-orm|postgres|valkey|rabbitmq|qdrant|keycloak|aws-sdk|@aws-sdk|s3' package.json apps packages; if ($hits) { $hits; exit 1 }
stop_if: Any write is needed outside allowed_files, including plans, docs/goals, parent directories, or sibling repositories.
The work requires a commit, push, pull request, remote repository creation, Tower/Coolify, DNS, credentials, or provider activation.
The work requires authentication, database/ORM, PostgreSQL, queues, object storage, or other excluded infrastructure.
A legal wording, brand-rights, dependency-version, or factual-content decision cannot be resolved truthfully with a clearly marked local placeholder.
A verification command fails twice for the same in-scope cause, or the built application does not render the root route.
Existing unrelated changes would be overwritten or the supplied logo asset cannot be copied without altering its artwork.
